case_studies.title: Contoso, Ltd.
case_studies.content:
**Overview**

Contoso is an online shop. Orders land in a PostgreSQL database; the analysts work in a lakehouse.

**Requirements**

- Load new orders every hour.
- Analysts must not see customers' e-mail addresses.

questions.question: Which file format stores data by column? (one answer)
questions.explanation: Parquet is **columnar**: a query reads only the columns it needs.

questions.question: Which two are table formats? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Iceberg and Delta add tables (schema, snapshots, ACID) on top of data files.
